cases.title: Time-series line with missing-value gaps

cases.title: Free two-dimensional cursor
cases.intent: Track an unconstrained x and y plot position without snapping to the nearest datum.

ai.create: Create a free two-dimensional crosshair that reports normalized plot coordinates at arbitrary pointer positions without selecting a datum.
ai.maintain: Keep cursor movement DOM-only, constrain it to resolved chart bounds, hide it on leave, and preserve one chart render while pointer state changes.

cases.title: Monthly-snapped brush selection
cases.intent: Select and revise a UTC month range with a direct horizontal drag that snaps both boundaries to observed months.

ai.create: Create a UTC line chart with an optional granular d3-brush controller, monthly-snapped selection, two semantic slider handles, touch cancellation, and a live range summary.
ai.maintain: Keep the full semantic domain in an injected D3 UTC scale, snap committed bounds to observed UTC months, synchronize the D3 brush extent and selection to resolved scene bounds, and keep selection state outside the renderer.

cases.title: Wheel zoom and pan time window
cases.intent: Zoom a continuous time viewport around the pointer, pan the cropped domain, and restore the full extent.

target.name: Zoomable time window. Focus the chart before wheel zoom; drag or use a horizontal wheel to pan; use plus, minus, arrow keys, or Home.
Zoomable time window. Focus the chart before wheel zoom; drag or use a horizontal wheel to pan; use plus, minus, arrow keys, or Home.

ai.create: Create a UTC time series with an optional granular d3-zoom controller that zooms around the pointer, pans by drag or horizontal wheel, and exposes keyboard, touch, status, and reset affordances.
ai.maintain: Keep the D3 zoom transform and application viewport synchronized across responsive updates, leave wheel and vertical touch scrolling unconsumed until intentional plot focus, expose the same keyboard and reset contract, and preserve D3 constraints rather than recreating transform math.

cases.title: Timeline playback scrubber
cases.intent: Scrub a semantic playhead through stable time frames with a direct drag while keeping the chart data controlled.

ai.create: Create a controlled UTC line chart with a native range input for the playback index, a visible playhead, play and pause control, keyboard support, and live frame status.
ai.maintain: Keep frame identity and playback state outside the renderer, align the native range to resolved chart coordinates, cancel transient edits without committing them, and preserve the index across responsive and data revisions.

cases.title: Editable event range
cases.intent: Edit a keyed schedule event by dragging its end handle while preserving the event start, lane, and identity.

ai.create: Create a keyed resource schedule with interval rectangles, a native semantic range aligned to the release end, a date input, keyboard editing, and a live duration summary.
ai.maintain: Preserve event IDs and lane assignment, clamp the end after the start, roll cancelled edits back to their origin, and update renderer input from application-owned state instead of mutating scene output.

cases.title: Pie with outside labels
cases.intent: Identify each contribution around a part-to-whole pie without relying on a separate legend.

source.title: Recharts Pie Chart With Customized Label

ai.create: Create a four-slice pie with stable categorical colors, radial leader lines, and one short outside label at each arc midpoint.
ai.maintain: Update totals while preserving source order, arc identity, responsive leader and label offsets, side-aware text anchors, and label-to-slice color.

cases.title: Donut with center total
cases.intent: Show a categorical composition while keeping its aggregate total visible in the center.

ai.create: Create a three-slice donut with a derived total centered in the readable inner ring.
ai.maintain: Recompute both the arcs and center total from the same revision while preserving stable category identities and the inner-radius ratio.

cases.title: Rounded donut with gaps
cases.intent: Separate a compact categorical composition with deliberate angular gaps and rounded arc ends.

source.title: Recharts Pie Chart With Padding Angle

ai.create: Create a five-slice donut with three-degree gaps, eight-pixel corners, and stable categorical fills.
ai.maintain: Update category totals while preserving explicit gap size, responsive radii, rounded corners, source order, and stable arc keys.

cases.title: Nested donut rings
cases.intent: Compare a high-level split and its detailed composition in two concentric rings.

ai.create: Create an inner two-slice summary ring and an outer four-slice detail ring with independent keyed D3 pie layouts.
ai.maintain: Update both levels together while preserving ring order, the gap between rings, stable identities, and responsive inner and outer radii.

cases.title: Nightingale rose chart
cases.intent: Compare six values through equal-angle sectors whose radii vary on one fixed scale.

ai.create: Create six equal-angle sectors whose outer radii encode values against a fixed zero-to-one-hundred domain.
ai.maintain: Update values without changing angle order or the radial domain; keep D3 arc accessors responsive and retain stable category keys.

cases.title: Threshold gauge with needle
cases.intent: Show one bounded reading against three threshold bands with a centered needle and value.
features: native radial rule ticks and needle

ai.create: Create a semicircular threshold gauge with three D3 pie sectors, eleven radial tick rules, a scale-driven radial rule needle, a radial dot hub, and a centered radial value label.
ai.maintain: Update the reading without changing threshold or tick boundaries; preserve stable keys, the zero-to-one-hundred angle domain, the responsive radius, and native polar mark ownership.

cases.title: Comparative radar chart
cases.intent: Compare current and target profiles across six qualitative dimensions on one fixed radial scale.

ai.create: Create a comparative radar chart with two keyed six-point profiles, a fixed zero-to-one-hundred radial scale, polygon grid rings, and sparse angle labels.
ai.maintain: Update either profile while preserving metric order, series identity, the fixed radial domain, closed D3 curves, and shared guide geometry.

cases.title: Concentric radial bars
cases.intent: Compare four bounded values through concentric rounded radial bars on one shared angular scale.

ai.create: Create four concentric radial bars with a fixed zero-to-one-hundred angular domain, responsive ring radii, stable category keys, and rounded D3 arc geometry.
ai.maintain: Update values without changing ring order or the shared angular domain; keep each D3 radius accessor responsive and preserve exact per-category fills.

cases.title: Sunburst hierarchy
cases.intent: Show part-to-whole relationships across two visible hierarchy depths using nested annular sectors.

ai.create: Create a two-ring sunburst from a typed hierarchy using d3-hierarchy partition output and a responsive D3 arc generator with inherited branch colors.
ai.maintain: Update leaf values while preserving hierarchy order, stable ancestry-path keys, global angular allocation, responsive ring thickness, and branch color inheritance.

cases.title: Equal Earth world choropleth
cases.intent: Compare values across recognizable world regions with an equal-area projection.

ai.create: Create a seven-region world choropleth using the same GeoJSON and Equal Earth projection for Observable Plot and TanStack geoShape.
ai.maintain: Preserve geographic coordinates, responsive projection fitting, stable region keys, literal fills, and one projected path per region.

cases.title: Projected proportional-symbol map
cases.intent: Compare place magnitudes with area-scaled circles over a projected world map.

ai.create: Create a proportional-symbol world map from seven region polygons and nine GeoJSON places, using the same Equal Earth projection and square-root radius scale in both renderers.
ai.maintain: Keep longitude and latitude semantic, sort-independent, and projection-backed; preserve stable place keys and area-scaled D3 point radii.

cases.title: Orthographic globe with graticule
cases.intent: Show projected land on a clipped globe with a geographic coordinate grid.

ai.create: Create an orthographic globe from a Sphere, a D3 graticule, and one GeoJSON land collection using the same rotated projection in Observable Plot and TanStack.
ai.maintain: Keep the sphere, graticule, land, rotation, clipping, responsive fit, and paint order aligned without drawing projection geometry manually.

cases.title: Great-circle route map
cases.intent: Trace long-distance routes and endpoints over a projected world.

ai.create: Create four great-circle routes with six projected endpoints over one world land path, using GeoJSON and the same Equal Earth projection in both renderers.
ai.maintain: Preserve route keys, endpoint coordinates, D3 geographic resampling, responsive projection fitting, and explicit stroke and point styles.

cases.title: Numeric polar line
cases.intent: Follow one cyclic quantitative profile through a continuous angular domain.

ai.create: Create one straight-segment polar line over a zero-to-three-hundred-sixty-degree angle domain and a fixed zero-to-one-hundred radius domain.
ai.maintain: Update radius values while preserving angular order, explicit domains, responsive center and radius, stable point identities, and the closing endpoint.

cases.title: Numeric polar scatter
cases.intent: Compare independent observations by angular position and radial magnitude.

source.title: Apache ECharts Polar Scatter Punch Card

ai.create: Create fourteen equally sized points over continuous zero-to-three-hundred-sixty-degree angle and zero-to-one-hundred radius domains.
ai.maintain: Update radial values while preserving angles, fixed domains, responsive layout, stable observation keys, and constant symbol size.

cases.title: World country choropleth
cases.intent: Compare values across real country boundaries with an equal-area world projection.

ai.create: Create a country-level Equal Earth choropleth from world-atlas countries-110m, converting TopoJSON once and rendering all 177 countries as keyed native geo marks.
ai.maintain: Update country values without replacing boundary geometry; preserve atlas identity, responsive projection fitting, stable country keys, binned fills, and theme-aware borders.

cases.title: United States state choropleth
cases.intent: Compare values across actual United States state and district boundaries.

ai.create: Create a 51-feature United States choropleth from us-atlas TopoJSON using the same responsive Albers USA projection and literal state fills in Observable Plot and TanStack geoShape.
ai.maintain: Preserve actual atlas boundaries, stable FIPS keys, the 50 states plus District of Columbia, Alaska and Hawaii insets, revision-driven fills, and one projected path per feature.

cases.title: Standard world projection gallery
cases.intent: Compare how four standard projections reshape the same real country atlas.

ai.create: Create a two-by-two projection gallery showing the same world-atlas country collection in Equal Earth, Natural Earth, Mercator, and equirectangular projections.
ai.maintain: Preserve pane order, shared atlas geometry, per-projection identity, responsive fitting, sphere outlines, and theme-aware borders while updating paint.
